item.title: Fire disrupts COP30 in Brazil: Belem venue evacuated; key climate talks stalled
item.description: A sudden fire broke out at the COP30 climate conference in Belem, prompting immediate evacuations and bringing crucial discussions to a standstill. While the flames consumed several exhibition pavilions, emergency services were swift in extinguishing the inferno.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Candace Owens drops explosive claim on Charlie Kirk's assassination with shocking twist about Tyler Robinson fingerprints
item.description: Candace Owens questions the official narrative surrounding Charlie Kirk's shooting, suggesting a planned setup involving multiple individuals. She claims Tyler Robinson's role was limited, with his fingerprints not being the only ones on the weapon. Owens also alleges Lance Twiggs played a more significant, albeit different, part in the incident, citing a TMZ video as evidence.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Indian-origin employee gifted $40,000 by McDonald’s restaurant owner after 40 years of service in US
item.description: After four decades of dedicated service at a McDonald's in Saugus, Massachusetts, Pargan Singh, endearingly called 'Balbir', has become a local hero. His colleagues, who have watched him grow from a beginner to a beloved team member, surprised him with a lavish red-carpet tribute and a generous $40,000 gift, celebrating an incredible journey of commitment and camaraderie.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

Man who has travelled to all 197 countries reveals the worst city he’s been to
item.description: Travel YouTuber Drew Binsky, who has visited all 197 countries, has revealed the cities he liked least after a decade on the road. Despite loving India and many challenging destinations, he named Conakry in Guinea as his worst experience, followed by N’Djamena in Chad and Delhi in India, each for safety, hardship or overwhelming conditions that left him eager to leave.

UK immigration crackdown: Migrants may face over 30-year waits to settle in Britain — all you need to know
item.description: Under Britain's revised immigration framework, certain migrants may find themselves on a lengthy journey towards permanent residency, facing wait times that could stretch to three decades. Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood emphasized that gaining settlement is a hard-won privilege based on contributions, rather than a guaranteed right.

item.title: Adin Ross causes storm online after announcing Nick Fuentes recognition in major event with Zack Asmongold
item.description: Adin Ross announced a new streamer awards show on Kick, partnering with Asmongold and Nick Lee. Ross controversially stated Nick Fuentes "deserves a f**king award," aiming for an unbiased event. This comes after Kick CEO Ed Craven withdrew funding for Ross's initial concept, leading to Lee's offer of support with new conditions.

item.title: Indian-origin author Deepak Chopra named in newly released Epstein files: Who is he and what do the emails show?
item.description: Newly revealed Epstein documents show a brief 2016 email exchange with author Deepak Chopra regarding a withdrawn lawsuit. The exchange, concerning a woman's allegations against Donald Trump and Epstein, was initiated by Epstein sharing a news link. Chopra inquired about the withdrawal of allegations against Epstein, receiving a short reply. No further ties are indicated.

item.title: 'I’m going to welcome thousands of people': Trump defends H-1B as MAGA accuses him of betraying 'America First'
item.description: In a recent speech, President Trump highlighted the vital role skilled foreign workers play in advancing technology projects, particularly referencing the upcoming chip factory in Arizona. He emphasized that these professionals not only bring expertise but are also essential for mentoring American workers in high-tech positions.

item.title: Trump puts the endangered in danger: White House moves to roll back key species protections
item.description: The Trump administration is rolling back Endangered Species Act protections, allowing economic factors to influence habitat designations and narrowing the definition of critical habitat. This move, critics warn, could significantly increase extinction risks for vulnerable wildlife by prioritizing development over scientific conservation needs and weakening automatic protections for threatened species.

item.title: Three members of America’s ‘most inbred family’ are now missing after state intervention
item.description: Three members of the Whittaker family, long known as America’s most inbred household, were quietly removed from their isolated home in Odd, West Virginia, after years of viral scrutiny. Relatives say they were given no explanation and still don’t know where the three were taken. Two siblings remain in the family’s deteriorated house, waiting for information that has not arrived.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Candace Owens reacts and hints at deeper truth as she questions missing Tyler Robinson video and Charlie Kirk last message
item.description: Candace Owens is questioning the disappearance of surveillance footage showing Tyler Robinson entering a sheriff's office after Charlie Kirk's death. The sheriff's office initially stated no footage existed, then claimed it was deleted after 30 days. Owens also shared Kirk's alleged final text message and suggested his death was a "military hit."
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Right-wing commentator Nick Fuentes says GOP must be ‘replaced’ with a left–right coalition: ‘That party would win 90% of votes’
item.description: In a bold statement, commentator Nick Fuentes has called for a radical overhaul of the Republican Party, emphasizing the need for a fresh populist alliance. He believes that the GOP has become too entwined with corporate interests and foreign labor immigration programs like H-1B visas, leaving American workers in the lurch.
